args.summary:
Built and verified a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box-girder bridge (30 + 45 + 30 m bearing-centre spans, deck 12.5 m wide).

Modeling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, elastic beam-column elements (MR-01); system: continuous_on_piers since both interior supports have pier-column data (MR-05).
- Main girder: single-cell cast_box section (B_top 12.5, B_bot 6.5, h 2.2, t_top/t_bot 0.25, t_web 0.5, cantilever 0.5→0.2) → A = 7.05 m², I = 4.7775 m⁴ (MR-02); C55 → Ec = 35500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ = 26 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), w = 183.3 kN/m, m = 18.685 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, 2 per line, Ge = 1.2 MPa manufacturer value): abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 2 PTFE sliding (longitudinal free, Kh = 0) 400×500/5 layers, 550×650/6 layers; Pier 1 plain fixed bearing (Kh = 13 091 kN/m) 600×700/7 layers. Kv values via JTG 3362-2018 8.7 (Ee = 5.4GeS², Eb = 2000 MPa).
- Piers 1 & 2: twin circular columns merged to single column (MR-06), D = 1.4 m, A = 3.0788 m², I = 0.37715 m⁴, C40 → Ec = 32500 MPa; lengths 6 m and 29 m, base fixed.
- Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes; ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/350/320 kN for the 30/45/30 m spans.

Key results:
- Fundamental vertical bending frequency f1 = 3.239 Hz (next modes 5.934, 6.555 Hz); impact factor μ = 0.1767·ln(f1) − 0.0157 = 0.192 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).
- Self-weight reactions (kN): abutment 0 = 1811, pier 1 = 7843, pier 2 = 7735, abutment 3 = 1858.
- Self-weight mid-span moments 6546 / 18945 / 7244 kNm; support moments −28150 / −26755 kNm.
- Lane-load extreme positive moment 11254 kNm (mid-span of the 45 m span); extreme negative moment −8975 kNm.

All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed. No unresolved defects.
